items: HARD I and HARD II difficulty tiers are now available for eligible dungeons.
New-player bonuses now apply through 15 clears, with extra party rewards.
Several dungeons received pacing, difficulty, and drop adjustments.
Sorcerer, Archer, Valkyrie, Priest, Mystic, and Warrior were adjusted.
Healer Strength and Tanker Endurance scaling were redesigned.
Accessory Etchings and stronger Annihilation armor stats were added.

blocks.text: The most impactful changes are the HARD difficulty tiers and the new healer/tanker stat scaling. Review those tabs before rebuilding gear.

blocks.title: Island of Dawn and Vanguard rewards

items: Style Etching crafting materials that used to drop from Island of Dawn now drop regardless of monster type.
The three material types drop from any monster, each at a different rate.
The shop that uses Dawnstorm Tokens has been reorganized.
The shop lineup has been refreshed and is now subject to a per-account purchase limit.
The shop lineup resets every 7 days.

The calculation method for the "% reduced skill cooldown" effect has been changed to multiplicative.
Example: Using a 100-second skill with a Glyph effect that reduces cooldown by 30% (with a 70% total cooldown reduction already applied from gear)
After gear-based cooldown reduction is applied, the Glyph's -30% is then calculated on the remaining 30 seconds.

blocks.caption: Updated Strength and Endurance stat display.

items: The stat display format has been changed.
Before: Base + Total Increased Stat Value
After: Base + Gear Total Value + Buff Stat Value
Since buff stats are not included in scaling, this change is made to prevent confusion.
The white-colored stat value is the figure that actually generates scaling-based efficiency.
The scaling starting threshold has been changed from 300 to 200.
A cap has been applied depending on the scaling range.
The cap does not apply to damage amplification stats.
For every 1 point of Strength, the following efficiency increase is applied.
Strength 200~500 range: 1%
Strength 500~600 range: 0.5%

rows: 650 or above (hard cap, no further increase)

items: The duration of Taunt skills has been reduced by 50% compared to before. (36 sec → 18 sec)
After a Taunt skill is applied to a monster, it will not be taunted again by a Taunt skill for a set period of time.
Taunt skills from other classes are likewise subject to this immunity for the duration.
Natural aggro generated by a monster's HP decreasing remains unchanged at 36 seconds.

blocks.text: The source describes the Tanker Endurance cap in two different ways: no additional efficiency beyond 550, but later a soft cap from 500~600 and a hard cap at 600. Confirm the effective breakpoint in game.

items: Tanker classes now gain additional effects proportional to their Endurance stat.
Increased Taunt duration when using a Taunt skill
Increased uptime for Perfect Defense effects
Amplified damage reduction effect on weapon gear while blocking
Additional effects depending on class
The Tanker class Endurance stat threshold starts applying from 200.
No additional efficiency is granted beyond 550 Endurance.
Common Effects
The effects below are examples by Endurance range. Efficiency increases proportionally even if Endurance is raised by just 1 point.
Example: At 300 Endurance, Perfect Defense's bonus duration is increased by 0.1 seconds.
For every 1 point of Endurance, the following efficiency is increased.
From the 500~600 range, a soft cap applies and the above values are halved.
From the 600 range, a hard cap applies and no further increase occurs.
The efficiency of the Armor Break skill has been increased.
Armor Break is 6% × 2 stacks, with each stack applying separately.
Example: At 500 Endurance, 12% + 12% combine for 24% efficiency.
Passive attack power is increased.
Warrior: Enhanced Defensive Stance
Brawler: Self-Control
